scripts.generate:assets: npm run manifest && npm run normalize-assets && npm run palette && npm run format:assets
scripts.diagram:overview: mmdc -i docs/diagrams/architecture-overview.mmd -o docs/diagrams/architecture-overview.svg && mmdc -i docs/diagrams/architecture-overview.mmd -o docs/diagrams/architecture-overview.png -w 2000 -s 2
scripts.diagram:deep: mmdc -i docs/diagrams/architecture-deep-dive.mmd -o docs/diagrams/architecture-deep-dive.svg && mmdc -i docs/diagrams/architecture-deep-dive.mmd -o docs/diagrams/architecture-deep-dive.png -w 2400 -s 2
scripts.diagram:export: npm run diagram:overview && npm run diagram:deep
